name: Flow-WLS
plain: Multistep with weights from a weighted least squares fit that discounts older history by γ^k, instead of exact interpolation through all history. The point is to limit weight growth at high order.
math: w=compute_wls_weights(dt,past_dts,deg,γ). x+=Σ w_k v_k. Defaults history 6, deg 2, γ=0.85.

claims.text: Paper title on regularized multistep integration for flow matching

audit.note: No regularisation term exists. sampling_ext.py:464-470: plain WLS with weights γ^k solved by pinv, and the polynomial integrated over dt. The weight-growth limit comes from decay weights and low degree.
